deviceIntro: Run this on your computer. It witnesses your Git commits and desktop AI chats, without their content. Human computers capture no agent tool calls and need no model-endpoint changes. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value.
agentIntro: Run this on the machine your agent will use. It registers that computer to your agent's wallet and starts the Provian observer, so the work it witnesses creates Provenance Envelopes the agent owns. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The setup link authorizes device registration only - it cannot move money or change any settings.
terminalHelp: On a Mac, press Cmd+Space, type Terminal, and press Return.
paste: 2. Paste this line and press Return
deviceAfter: The response prints your device credentials (PROVIAN_DEVICE_KEY / PROVIAN_DEVICE_SECRET) - save them; they are shown once.
agentAfter: Follow the observer’s setup instructions. Setup completes after the selected witness sees a real new model response calling at least one tool. That response creates one PE, including an errored tool call. Where the agent keeps no session records on that computer, it runs "$HOME/.provian/bin/provian" process-lane record once from its own harness there; from then on each command it runs there is witnessed and creates one PE.

factor: A verified beneficiary link supplies a separate 2.0× linkage factor. Verified Apple App Attest, or verified platform attestation bound to a signed Provian observer release, can supply the hardware-rooted 4.0× class. Other verified hardware reports remain facts at the normal lane price

batchCadence: Your agent’s work reaches your phone once a day. A presentation or an on-demand payout sends it right away.
settlementCadence: Standard earnings settle on a schedule Provian sets, currently every 30 days per payee, counted from that payee’s last standard settlement UTC date. Genesis grants mint daily. An on-demand payout costs $1 USDC, paid by the agent from its own wallet or by its human.
